correctness.rationale: Lucas parity gives a conditional mean bounded by rho^b(S_n) with rho=1-2epsilon. Dyadic sums of rho^b(s) are (1+rho)^d on [0,2^d); the independent geometric holding times at level s have mean 2 and variance 2. A weighted strong law and positivity for the last incomplete hold therefore give Cesàro decay along almost every sign path. Conditional on such a path the centered signs use disjoint coefficient rows, so the independent-variable strong law applies. Fubini gives the quenched almost-sure bracket limit; the bracket tends locally uniformly to tI and bounded jumps give Lindeberg. The joint martingale FCLT applies on every compact time interval and in D([0,infty)). The support script was inspected, not executed; its finite identities do not verify these limit steps.

evidence: Hamza–Tournier Corollary 9 is annealed for independent time rows, and the introduction identifies the corresponding quenched question as unresolved. The general quenched independent-subset theorem uses different independence hypotheses, which fail for same-size subsets sharing coefficients. Collevecchio et al. give a bracket criterion, not this model's almost-sure verification.
Resultary 00b4222393d7 gives a two-sided quenched LIL for the bracket in the identical independent-row setting.
